allow_redisplay_filters.description: Uses the `allow_redisplay` value of each saved payment method to filter the set presented to a returning customer. By default, only saved payment methods with ’allow_redisplay: ‘always’ are shown in Checkout.

payment_method_remove.description: Enable customers to choose if they wish to remove their saved payment methods. Disabled by default.

payment_method_save.description: Enable customers to choose if they wish to save their payment method for future use. Disabled by default.
